# U35: An admin corrects people, goals and a past check-in in the data tables; anyone filters the activity and saves it

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `DATA-TABLES`, `CHANGE-LOG`
- **Budget:** at most 26 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `one-action` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/data?t=people` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 2762

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- _Note:_ Everyone can open the tables; an admin types into cells across tables, then reviews and saves once.
- Go to `/data?t=people` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Job title, Oskar Lindgren” field shows.
- **Step.** Type “Staff engineer, DevEx” into the “Job title, Oskar Lindgren” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Check-ins” tab.
- _Note:_ Property filters: a goal from its list of values, and a number condition; then sort by a column.
- **Step.** Press the “Filters” button.
- Choose “Goal” in the “Property” field in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- _Note:_ With 126 goals the Goal filter starts as “contains”; “is” gives the list of goals to pick from.
- Choose “is” in the “Condition” field in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Pull requests with AI-assisted review” field in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Add filter” button in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Filters” button.
- Choose “Week” in the “Property” field in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- Choose “gte” in the “Condition” field in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- **Step.** Type “38” into the “Value” field in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Add filter” button in the “Add a filter” dialog.
- **Check:** “Goal is Pull requests with AI-assisted review” is shown (else: the goal filter is not shown as words).
- **Check:** “Week ≥ 38” is shown (else: the week filter is not shown as words).
- **Step.** Press the “Week” button in the thead in the dtable (`.dtable thead`).
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if filtered and sorted weeks: {weeks.join(', ')}.
- _Note:_ A note the demo's generator gives this goal in weeks 41 and 44 (demo text varied in the 8 Nov review).
- **Step.** Type “No surprises” into the “Find a row” search field.
- Press the Enter key in the “Find a row” search field.
- **Check:** “rows match(es)?.” is shown in the count line (else: Data does not count what the search matches).
- **Check:** The “Why, Pull requests with AI-assisted review, week” field shows.
- **Step.** Type {worked out in the journey as `was.replace('No surprises', 'Nothing unexpected')`} into the “Why, Pull requests with AI-assisted review, week” field.
- **Check:** “2 changes in 2 rows, not saved yet” is shown (else: the tables do not say what is waiting to be saved).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if a changed cell is not marked as changed.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “edited”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Review changes” button.
- **Check:** “Oskar Lindgren” is shown in the “Review your changes” dialog (else: the review does not show the person change).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the words “fixing first” in the “Review your changes” dialog is not visible (else: the review found problems with the edits).
- _Note:_ Changing a week's check-in corrects it, as the check-in screen does: the review asks why first (#225's review, medium 6).
- **Step.** Type “The note named the wrong week” into the “Why are you correcting this check-in?” field in the “Review your changes” dialog.
- **Step.** Press the “Save 2 changes” button in the “Review your changes” dialog.
- **Check:** “Saved 2 changes” is shown (else: saving the tables did not confirm).
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if the person or the check-in correction was not saved and logged.
- _Note:_ Someone who isn't an admin can look but not change anything.
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/data` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Admins can change them here” is shown (else: a non-admin is not told who can change the data).
- **Check:** (`errors`) the part `.dtable input, .dtable select` is not there (else: a non-admin can type into the data tables).
- Close this browser.
- _Note:_ Activity: kind, who and when, all in the link; then save what's shown.
- Go to `/activity` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Check-ins” button in the “Kind of change” group.
- **Check:** The address becomes “kind=checkins”.
- **Step.** Press the “Filter(s / and sort)” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Only my changes” field in the “Filter activity” dialog.
- _Note:_ Demo review, 8 Nov, item 12: no filter is offered greyed out with no reason.
- **Check:** It fails if Activity filters offered greyed out with no reason: {greyed.join(', ')}.
- **Step.** Press the “Show the changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “who=grace”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the address matches “kind=checkins” and the address matches “who=grace” (else: the activity filters are not in the link).
- **Check:** “N changes match(es)?.” is shown (else: the filtered activity does not say how many it shows).
- _Note:_ On a phone, Save .csv is in the Filters sheet's footer rather than a row of the filter bar.
- If on a phone:
  - **Step.** Press the “Filter(s / and sort)” button.
  - **Step.** Press the “Save .csv” button in the “Filter activity” dialog.
- Otherwise:
  - **Step.** Press the “Save .csv” button.
- **Check:** (`progress`) it fails if Save .csv did not download the filtered log.
- Close this browser.
